calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line AS f
INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON (p.product_key = f.product_key)
INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON (d.calendar_date = f.sale_date)
WHERE f.store_key = 24
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.calendar_date,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units
FROM fact_sales_line AS f
INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON (d.calendar_date = f.sale_date)
WHERE f.store_key = 24
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

SELECT 
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line AS f
INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON (p.product_key = f.product_key)

WHERE f.store_key = 24
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
